info.name: B2W Ops API
info.description:
Ops API 2.0. Set baseUrl and the credential variables on this collection. Auth requests save AccessToken onto the collection. Every other request uses {{baseUrl}} and inherits the collection bearer token.

1. Open the collection Variables tab and set baseUrl (for example http://localhost/OpsAPI).
2. Set one credential pair: userName and password, or clientId and clientSecret, or tidUuid and apiSecret, or trimbleToken.
3. Run the matching request in the Auth folder.
4. Run any other request. Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}} is inherited from this collection.

item.name: Auth
Login with user name and password

exec: console.warn('Login succeeded but AccessToken was missing.');
console.log('Saved AccessToken on the collection. Other requests inherit it.');

request.description: GET /Login. userName must be DOMAIN\user or user@domain. On 200, AccessToken is stored in the collection variable accessToken.

item.name: Login with client ID and secret

exec: console.warn('Login succeeded but AccessToken was missing.');
console.log('Saved AccessToken on the collection. Other requests inherit it.');

request.description: GET /Login. The token is issued for the built-in system administrator. On 200, AccessToken is stored in the collection variable accessToken.

item.name: Login with TID uuid and API secret

exec: console.warn('Login succeeded but AccessToken was missing.');
console.log('Saved AccessToken on the collection. Other requests inherit it.');

request.description: GET /Login using the API secret stored on the Ops user. Trimble ID must be enabled on the site. On 200, AccessToken is stored in the collection variable accessToken.

exec: console.warn('Login succeeded but AccessToken was missing.');
console.log('Saved AccessToken on the collection. Other requests inherit it.');

request.description: GET /LoginWithTID. This request overrides the collection auth and sends the Trimble ID token from {{trimbleToken}}. On 200, the Ops AccessToken is stored in {{accessToken}} for every other request.

item.description: These requests do not inherit the collection bearer token. Each one saves AccessToken onto the collection so every other request can inherit it. Fill in one credential pair on the collection Variables tab, then run the matching request.

item.name: Service

request.description: GET /Ping/{input}. Returns the host name and the input text. Default input is hello.
GET /Version. Returns the Ops API version as plain text.

item.description: Reachability checks. Neither call requires a token. They inherit the collection auth, which these endpoints ignore.
